decisions.reason: Conferencing sits close to the firm's voice and data expertise, so it can read early results and improve the service, although competition from cloud collaboration tools adds some risk.
The metro data centre network builds directly on the firm's owned fibre and data centre footprint and already shows customer adoption, so its knowledge base strongly supports it.
Optical spectrum connectivity extends the firm's core fibre engineering knowledge and fits its high-bandwidth strategy, and it is prominently presented on a page of its own.
The number ordering portal builds on the firm's voice operations and software platforms and supports its push toward real-time self-service provisioning.
Carrier pre-selection is close to the firm's voice know-how and easy to manage, but it is a declining legacy regulated service, which raises the chance it is withdrawn.
Direct voice network connection builds on the firm's existing voice infrastructure and enterprise customer base, so it is low-risk to keep and improve.
